context: Tests whether the agent writes use case specifications at the business level, avoids technical implementation language in steps, structures alternative flows correctly with step-number triggers and returns, files each use case separately with the correct naming convention, and numbers business rules per use case.

checklist.name: UC-001 file name
checklist.description: The file docs/use_cases/UC-001-book-room.md exists with exactly that name (kebab-case, correct ID prefix)

checklist.name: UC-002 file name
checklist.description: The file docs/use_cases/UC-002-check-in-guest.md exists with exactly that name (kebab-case of the diagram name, not 'checkin-guest')

checklist.name: One use case per file
checklist.description: Each file documents exactly one use case — UC-001 file does NOT contain UC-002 content and vice versa

checklist.name: No SMTP/email-protocol steps
checklist.description: Neither file contains the words 'SMTP', 'sendmail', 'email server', or similar protocol-level terms in any step

checklist.name: No HTTP/API steps
checklist.description: Neither file contains 'REST', 'POST', 'GET', 'JSON', '/v1/charges', 'API call', or similar web-protocol terms in any step; the payment is described as a business action (e.g. 'Payment Service confirms the deposit')

checklist.name: No key-card encoding steps
checklist.description: Neither file contains 'RFID', 'Mifare', 'DESFire', 'encodes the card', or similar lock-technology terms in any step; issuing the key is described as a business action (e.g. 'System issues a key card for the room')

checklist.name: No SQL/database steps
checklist.description: Neither file contains 'INSERT', 'SELECT', 'SQL', 'database record', or similar persistence implementation terms in any step

checklist.name: Alt flow trigger references step number
checklist.description: Every alternative flow in both files has a Trigger line that references a specific numbered step (e.g., '(step 3)') rather than a vague condition

checklist.name: Alt flow ending
checklist.description: Every alternative flow in both files ends with either a return to a numbered step (e.g., 'Use case continues at step N') or an explicit ending ('Use case ends')

checklist.name: At least one alt flow per use case
checklist.description: UC-001 has at least one alternative flow AND UC-002 has at least one alternative flow

checklist.name: Business rule IDs scoped per use case
checklist.description: Each file numbers its business rules BR-001, BR-002, ... without gaps, and the second file starts again at BR-001; any reference to a rule of the other use case is qualified with its use case id (e.g. 'UC-001 BR-002'), never a bare BR id

checklist.name: Business rules present
checklist.description: Both files contain at least one business rule each, and every business rule has a BR-XXX formatted ID

checklist.name: Main scenario numbered steps
checklist.description: The Main Success Scenario in each file uses sequentially numbered steps with no gaps
